description: Retrieval and answer evaluation set for the document chat: Commission Regulation (EU) 2019/2020 in German and English plus three fictional luminaire datasheets. Relevance is labelled per PDF page (1-based).

questions.question: Ab welchem Datum gelten die Ökodesign-Anforderungen der Verordnung 2019/2020?
questions.note: Article 11; Annex II repeats the date for each block of requirements.

questions.question: How long does the endurance test for LED light sources run and how many switching cycles does it include?
questions.note: Annex V: 1 200 cycles, 3 000 h on, 3 600 h total.

questions.question: Welchen Lichtstrom muss ein Produkt haben, damit es nach der Verordnung als Lichtquelle gilt?
questions.note: Article 2(1)(c): between 60 and 82 000 lm.

questions.question: What efficiency does the best available separate control gear reach according to the benchmarks?
questions.note: Annex VI benchmarks.

questions.question: Wie lange gibt der Hersteller Garantie auf die Viaro?
questions.note: Viaro warranty; Galerion has 7 years, so the product name must decide.

questions.question: In which ambient temperature range can the Arenis floodlight be operated?
questions.note: Arenis operating temperature; the other datasheets list different ranges.

questions.question: Aus welchem Material besteht das Gehäuse der Galerion Tunnelleuchte?
questions.note: Stainless steel 1.4404; page 1 names the material, page 2 the grade.

questions.question: By when does the Commission have to present its review of Regulation 2019/2020 to the Consultation Forum?
questions.note: Article 9: no later than 25 December 2024.

questions.question: Wie weit darf der bei der Marktüberwachung gemessene Nutzlichtstrom unter dem angegebenen Wert liegen?
questions.note: Annex IV Table 6: declared value minus 10 %.

questions.question: Welchen Grenzwert hat die Standby-Leistung Psb einer Lichtquelle?
questions.note: Annex II 1(a), last sentence on the page.

questions.question: What is the Pst LM limit for flicker of LED mains light sources?
questions.note: Annex II Table 4.

questions.question: Does Regulation 2019/2020 apply to light sources approved for potentially explosive atmospheres under Directive 2014/34/EU?
questions.note: Annex III point 1(a): exempt.

questions.question: Welche Artikelnummer hat die Viaro mit 4000 K und 8 400 lm?
questions.note: Variant list; neighbouring numbers differ in one character.

questions.question: What luminous flux and system power does NL-7230-5KA45 have?
questions.note: Arenis variant list.

questions.question: Was für eine Leuchte ist die NL-5520-4KG30 und welchen Lichtstrom hat sie?
questions.note: Galerion counter-beam variant.

questions.question: Für welche Beleuchtungsklassen nach EN 13201-2 ist die Viaro geeignet?
questions.note: EN 13201-2 also appears in the Galerion datasheet, without classes.

questions.question: What SVM limit applies to the stroboscopic effect of LED mains light sources?
questions.note: Annex II Table 4.

questions.question: Wie läuft die Dauerprüfung für LED-Lichtquellen ab, wie lange ist die Lichtquelle pro Schaltzyklus ein- und ausgeschaltet?
questions.note: German question, search limited to the English regulation (Annex V).

questions.question: Welchen Farbwiedergabeindex müssen Lichtquellen mindestens erreichen, und gilt das auch für Außenbeleuchtung?
questions.note: German question, English regulation only (Annex II Table 4).

questions.question: Which older lighting regulations does Regulation 2019/2020 repeal, and from which date?
questions.note: English question, German regulation only (Article 10).

questions.question: Welche Schlagfestigkeit nach IK-Code hat der Arenis Fluter?
questions.note: German question on the English-only datasheet; Viaro is IK08, Galerion IK09.

questions.question: What surge protection does the Viaro street luminaire have?
questions.note: English question on a German-only datasheet.

questions.question: Can the Galerion tunnel luminaire be cleaned with a high-pressure washer?
questions.note: English question on a German-only datasheet.

questions.question: Und wie schwer ist sie?
questions.previous: Welche Schutzart hat die Viaro Straßenleuchte?
questions.note: Product only known from the previous question.

questions.question: And which variant gives the most light?
questions.previous: Which beam options are available for the Arenis floodlight?
questions.note: Product only known from the previous question.

questions.question: Und wie viele Jahre Garantie gibt es darauf?
questions.previous: Welchen Lichtstromerhalt gibt das Datenblatt der Galerion an?
questions.note: Product only known from the previous question; Viaro has 10 years.

questions.question: Gilt das auch für separate Betriebsgeräte?
questions.previous: Welcher Grenzwert gilt nach der Verordnung 2019/2020 für die Standby-Leistung einer Lichtquelle?
questions.note: Topic (standby limit) only known from the previous question.

questions.question: And what about control gears for LED light sources?
questions.previous: What minimum efficiency does the regulation require for separate control gears for HID light sources above 405 W?
questions.note: Table 3: formula Pcg^0,81/(1,09 x Pcg^0,81 + 2,10).

questions.question: Was kostet die Viaro NL-4012-4KB10 im Einkauf?
questions.note: No prices in any document.

questions.question: What is the luminous flux of the 600 W variant of the Arenis floodlight?
questions.note: Arenis stops at 290 W; there is no 600 W variant.

questions.question: Welche Bußgelder sieht die Verordnung 2019/2020 bei Verstößen gegen die Ökodesign-Anforderungen vor?
questions.note: The regulation sets no penalties; those are national law.

questions.question: What is the delivery time for the Galerion tunnel luminaire?
questions.note: No delivery times in any document.
